enchantments.tooltip: Resistance +7: Passive: +7 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Insightful Fortification +52%: +52% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

Shield +9: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +9 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.
Natural Armor +9: Passive: +9 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Lost Purpose: This item is missing some parts that made it unique. Perhaps you can fix that at a Cannith Repurposing Station.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
